## Acknowledgements

I used [Sam Shanny-Csik's documentation](https://github.com/samanthacsik/strava-dashboard/wiki/Creating-a-Strava-API-Application-&-authentication) for getting API access and used much of her data cleaning pipeline for wrangling the data.

## Data Wrangling 

```{r}
# load libraries
library(rStrava)
library(tidyverse)
library(hms)
library(janitor)
```

```{r}
# authenticate account and create token
my_token <- httr::config(token = strava_oauth(app_name, app_client_id, app_secret,
                                              app_scope = "activity:read_all"))
```

```{r}
# get all activities
my_activities <- get_activity_list(stoken = my_token)

# convert lists of activities into data frame
activities_df <- compile_activities(my_activities)
```

```{r}
# save copy of raw activities data as csv
# write_csv(activities_df, "../data/raw/strava_activities_raw.csv") # comment out so I don't accidentally run/overwrite
```

```{r}
activities_df |> 
  mutate(start_datetime = as_datetime(start_date), # works
         start_date = date(start_datetime), # works; replaces original start_date; now as date var instead of chr
         start_year = year(start_datetime), # works
         start_month = month(start_datetime), # works
         start_day = day(start_datetime), # works
         start_time = as_hms(start_datetime)) # works
```

```{r}
# preliminary cleaning
clean_activities <- activities_df %>%
  
  # rename variables
  rename(start_lat = start_latlng1,
         start_long = start_latlng2,
         end_lat = end_latlng1,
         end_long = end_latlng2,
         avg_speed = average_speed,
         max_elev = elev_high,
         min_elev = elev_low,
         total_elev_gain = total_elevation_gain) %>%
  
  # convert pr_count var to numerics
  mutate(pr_count = as.numeric(pr_count),
         
         # parse dates
         # UTC 0 version
         start_datetime = as_datetime(start_date), 
         start_date = date(start_datetime),
         start_year = year(start_datetime), 
         start_month = month(start_datetime),
         start_day = day(start_datetime),
         start_time = hms::as_hms(start_datetime),
         
         # local version
         start_datetime_local = as_datetime(start_date_local),
         start_date_local = date(start_datetime_local),
         start_year_local = year(start_datetime_local), 
         start_month_local = month(start_datetime_local),
         start_day_local = day(start_datetime_local),
         start_time_local = hms::as_hms(start_datetime_local),
         
         # rename some of the sport types
         sport_type = str_replace(sport_type, "AlpineSki", "Alpine Ski"),
         sport_type = str_replace(sport_type, "HighIntensityIntervalTraining", "HIIT"),
         sport_type = str_replace(sport_type, "NordicSki", "Nordic Ski"),
         sport_type = str_replace(sport_type, "Ride", "Bike"),
         sport_type = str_replace(sport_type, "RockClimbing", "Rock Climbing"),
         sport_type = str_replace(sport_type, "RollerSki", "Rollerski"),
         sport_type = str_replace(sport_type, "StairStepper", "Stair Stepper"),
         sport_type = str_replace(sport_type, "WeightTraining", "Weight Training"),
         
         # and types
         type = str_replace(type, "AlpineSki", "Alpine Ski"),
         type = str_replace(type, "HighIntensityIntervalTraining", "HIIT"),
         type = str_replace(type, "NordicSki", "Nordic Ski"),
         type = str_replace(type, "Ride", "Bike"),
         type = str_replace(type, "RockClimbing", "Rock Climbing"),
         type = str_replace(type, "RollerSki", "Rollerski"),
         type = str_replace(type, "StairStepper", "Stair Stepper"),
         type = str_replace(type, "WeightTraining", "Weight Training")) %>%
  
  select(!c(contains("heart"), photo_count, average_cadence, trainer, 
            has_kudoed, from_accepted_tag, flagged, commute, resource_state,
            athlete.resource_state, athlete.id_str, upload_id_str, workout_type,
            type, tags, suffer_score, id_str, device_name))
```

```{r}
# more datetime cleaning, converting units, changing to factors
clean_activities <- clean_activities %>%
  
  # convert to imperial (mph, miles, feet, etc)
  mutate(avg_speed = round((avg_speed * 0.621371), 2),
         distance = round((distance * 0.621371), 2),
         max_elev = round((max_elev * 3.281), 2),
         min_elev = round((min_elev * 3.281), 2),
         total_elev_gain = round((total_elev_gain * 3.281), 2),
         
         # create lubridate periods from seconds
         elapsed_time = (seconds_to_period(elapsed_time)),
         moving_time = seconds_to_period(moving_time)) |> 
  
  # convert certain vars to factors
  mutate(across(.cols = c("manual", "private", "sport_type", "visibility"),
                .fns = fct)) %>%
  
  # clean column names
  clean_names() |> 

  # rearrange columns
  relocate(start_datetime:start_time_local, .after = start_date_local) |> 
  relocate(start_date, .after = start_datetime) |> 
  relocate(start_date_local, .after = start_datetime_local)
```
